pkgmetadata.longdescription:
DYMO's CUPS drivers for the LabelWriter 550 series: the 550, 550 Turbo, 550 Pro, 550 Twin Pro, 5XL, 5XL Pro and LabelWriter Wireless, plus the MobileLabeler tape printer. ::gentoo's net-print/dymo-cups-drivers covers the LabelWriter 4xx and older; this package installs alongside it, since DYMO named its newer filters raster2dymolw_v2 and raster2dymolm_v2.
The filter reads the printer's status before every job, so it works on queues that reach the printer directly (USB or network), not on raw or Windows-shared queues. The 550 series only prints on DYMO labels; the printer enforces that itself.
